# HAST Quality Fixtures

- `canonical-hast-v1.fb`: frozen HAST 1.0 structure/identity fixture. SHA256
  `fba30b0a37d330bac7eb7794f8624dda64f12163f853e23449574ca3d67c57ea`.
  Native quality remains unreported; do not rewrite this file to add flags.
- `semantic-quality-v1_1.fb`: generated by Helix native
  `FlatBufSerializerTest.EmitsAssessedSemanticConsumerFixture`. It represents a
  typed record-field return, evaluated by the C-AST optimizer before serialization.
  SHA256 `a9a98a6c8a22f275060ab82fbf0ab091f3eeda74d7971f246131b1ee740d9259`.
- `native-quality-mixed-v1_1.fb`: generated by native
  `FlatBufSerializerTest.NativeQualityIsFunctionScopedAndExplicit`. It tests
  per-function transport of assessed clean, known-loss, and unreported states;
  the flags are explicit test inputs, not a claim about a real binary.
  SHA256 `5683f91b2b4104b39b3ebfd69f46188881c3ad05ca1219c724463af58f92e1f7`.

Generation is opt-in via `HELIX_HAST_SEMANTIC_FIXTURE_OUT` and
`HELIX_HAST_QUALITY_FIXTURE_OUT`. Keep compiler/native provenance alongside
acceptance reports. No-known-loss permits evaluation; it does not prove source
equivalence, runtime behavior, or security impact.
